notes.title: IRON GUARD is now available on the Meta Quest Store!
notes.notes:
Today is an important day for us - [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5153768677983339/]IRON GUARD is now available on the Meta Quest Store![/url]

For this we had to work hard to hit this milestone, but the great news is that now the game performs even better. Those who have already tried the game on Applab, you should see this difference considerably, especially if you are a  Quest 1 owner.

Here is a list of the main changes included in the Meta Store released version:

[list]
[*] Changed the teleport
[*] Improved performance and visuals
[*] Increased the brightness of some dark maps
[*] Changed the effect of taking damage
[*] Reduced build weight to <900 MB
[*] Changed the design of some elements
[*] Added the ability to change the height of the player (under settings in level)
[*] Reduced loading time
[/list]

Thank you for your time! We are glad you'll be joining us on this exciting adventure, because this is just beginning!

notes.title: IRON GUARD VR for Meta Quest 2
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! Did you know that IRON GUARD VR is also available for our friends with the Meta Quest 2 headset? Which means you can play IRON GUARD VR anywhere, without connecting to a computer.

[url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5153768677983339/]The game is currently available on AppLab[/url], but your support and feedback can help us tremendously, to get onto the official Oculus Quest store, as we go through the approval process. 

We are also available via [url=https://sidequestvr.com/app/6178/iron-guard]SideQuest[/url], who have been our amazing support.  

Lastly, we are working on some interesting updates. But it's still top secret!  ːrobosmileː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41850972/28a37660cd05bbc3b8f9796168c1307a0ceeba5c.png[/img]

[b]Are you a YouTuber or a streamer?[/b] If you have an audience, please contact us at ig@xlabdigital.com and we will be happy to share with you keys to review the game and support your community.

notes.title: Gamepad Support is now available!
notes.notes:
Despite the difficult global events which have created many challenges, we're happy to announce, release of a major patch. In addition to many fixes and improvements, Iron Guard now has support for the gamepad!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41850972/a6a097e0beb4bd46b8e2a761cfc6be3c73202cf2.png[/img]

It wasn't as easy as we thought, but the game now fully supports Xbox and DualShock/DualSense controllers and their equivalents.

Also, due to popular demand from players, we have added a button to reset Skill Points (SP), which you can find in the upper right corner of the Upgrades screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41850972/140344a50fb203789fc030d63d6b616c104a4452.png[/img]

Lastly the Flamethrower turret balance has also been adjusted for better experience.

Thank you all for your patience and support.
Happy gaming!

notes.title: IRON GUARD is out on Steam!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that IRON GUARD is out on Steam today!

You probably didn't know, but [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1213220/IRON_GUARD_VR/]IRON GUARD was originally a VR game[/url]. However, after releasing the game on PC VR and [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5153768677983339/?utm_source=oculusapplab.com]Oculus Quest 2[/url], we decided why not make a PC version as well? So now you too can join the adventures of First Officer Graves and find out what caused the disaster.


As it usually happens, we’ve been rushing to finish the project and although we tested it as much as possible  we could have overlooked things and therefore if you encounter any bugs please let us know. We will be glad to get your feedback. In the next patch, we plan to add some small fixes and improvements, as well as add support for gamepad controllers.

We are sure that you will especially enjoy our groovy soundtrack and as a bonus [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747420/IRON_GUARD_Soundtrack/]we released it for absolutely free[/url], be sure to download it!

We wish you happy gaming!
